claims.head: Best against best
claims.body: The Blues are the league’s best for chance quality, and the Wild are one of the league’s best at preventing dangerous shots. We’ll side with the Blues.
claims.call: The Blues’ chances are more dangerous than the league average (a 6.3% chance of scoring on the average shot) against the Wild.
claims.nums: St. Louis 1st for chance quality (a 6.9% chance of scoring on the average shot) · Minnesota 4th for preventing dangerous shots
claims.gist: It’s strength against strength: the Blues for chance quality, the Wild at preventing dangerous shots.

claims.head: Active D against forward-led
claims.body: On shots from defensemen, St. Louis is near the top of the league and Minnesota is near the bottom of the league. That’s about as far apart as two teams get.
claims.nums: Shots from defensemen: St. Louis 6th, Minnesota 27th
claims.gist: The Blues and the Wild sit at opposite ends for shots from defensemen.
claims.call: The Blues’ defensemen take a bigger share of the team’s shot attempts than the Wild’s.

MIN.head: The matchup suits Minnesota
MIN.body: The two have been about even at controlling the play lately and Minnesota has home ice. St. Louis can make it interesting if they keep dangerous shots away.
